label: FROZEN INVENTED-DATA IMPLEMENTATION CHECK; NOT PROJECT OR TIMESTAMP INFERENCE
source_pin: The commit containing this plan; only CRLF/LF differences allowed, with actual raw worktree SHA256 recorded before/after

preflight_correction.failure: Git LF blobs differ from Windows CRLF worktree bytes only

method: Uniform full-support prior on integer population totals; hypergeometric PPR; union over unread sampled labels
confidence_set_evaluations: Every prefix, including the empty prefix, of every full random permutation
stopping_diagnostics: First upper bound <= 0.10 after at least 20 draws, otherwise census

missingness_details.hide_errors: Unread if the fixed true label is one
missingness_details.hide_nonerrors: Unread if the fixed true label is zero
missingness_details.bursts: Unread at zero-based positions with position modulo 7 in 0,1,2

implementation_QA_rule.exact_checks: All focused rational-reference and exact random-order tests must pass before freeze
implementation_QA_rule.monte_carlo: Complete every path; simultaneous one-sided 95% Bonferroni CP upper bounds on anytime noncoverage must each be <= 0.075
implementation_QA_rule.interpretation: A finite QA screen, not proof of coverage, source qualification or adoption for historical audits

stop_policy: Final stop; no retry or automatic resume; incomplete work never passes
prohibitions: No A2 replay or replacement bound
No SEC, market data, models, real labels, return evaluation or holdout
No ledger row, push or tag
